title: KainClaw Design 版本历史：snapshot store + list/restore
description: 实现版本快照机制：生成/patch 后自动保存版本，提供最近版本列表与恢复。目标是让 Design 工作台有基本的可回退能力，而不是一次性页面。
acceptance_criteria: 生成与 patch 后有版本快照；可列出最近版本并恢复；恢复后预览与 sliders 同步；补测试；npm test/check/build 通过。
notes: Implemented V1 design version history with a lightweight local version store, automatic snapshots after generate/patch, renderer version list UI, and restore flow that rehydrates HTML/sliders back into the workbench. Verified with focused tests, npm test, npm run check, and npm run build.

title: KainClaw Design 导出 V1：HTML / PDF
description: 实现导出 V1：先做 HTML / PDF 导出，保持现有依赖边界可控。PPTX 不并入这一任务，避免在未确认依赖策略前把主线做重。
acceptance_criteria: 当前 Design 结果可导出 HTML 与 PDF；导出失败有明确错误；补测试或最小可验证链路；npm test/check/build 通过。
notes: Implemented Design export V1: local HTML export with slider values inlined, minimal Electron PDF export IPC via printToPDF, workbench export buttons, and exportDone feedback. Verified with focused tests, npm test, npm run check, and npm run build.

title: KainClaw Design 工作台：page-design 骨架 + generate IPC + iframe/sliders
description: 实现 `page-design` 工作台骨架：进入设计页、prompt 输入、generate IPC、iframe 预览、sliders 面板与本地 slider 应用。目标是打通从需求到可预览 HTML 的第一条完整用户链路。
acceptance_criteria: page-design 可进入；design:generate 跑通；iframe 能显示生成结果；sliders 拖动不重调 AI；补测试；npm test/check/build 通过。
notes: Implemented the first usable page-design workbench loop: design:generate host wiring, renderer prompt/generate controls, iframe preview, and local sliders application without re-calling the model. Verified with focused tests, npm test, npm run check, and npm run build.

title: KainClaw Design patch loop：元素选取 + inline comment + partial patch
description: 实现局部改图链路：元素选取、inline comment、`design:patch` IPC、selector 定位与局部 HTML patch。目标是让用户能在不重写整页的前提下，对 Design 结果做局部迭代。
acceptance_criteria: 可选中元素并提交局部评论；patch 只改目标节点；失败时不破坏现有 HTML；补测试；npm test/check/build 通过。
notes: Implemented the first KainClaw Design patch loop: patchEngine prompt/parse/apply path, Electron host design:patch wiring, renderer element selection + inline comment popover, and patch result refresh without rewriting the whole page. Verified with focused tests, npm test, npm run check, and npm run build.

title: KainClaw Design 基础层：designPrompt / slidersExtractor / designEngine 契约
description: 实现 KainClaw Design 的基础层：`designPrompt.ts`、`slidersExtractor.ts`、`designEngine.ts` 的最小可用契约。目标是稳定产出并解析 `HTML + sliders JSON` 结构化结果，为后续 workbench/UI 铺底，不直接做完整页面交互。
acceptance_criteria: 能从 provider 输出稳定解析 HTML 与 sliders；失败路径有清晰错误；补单元测试；npm test/check/build 通过。
notes: Implemented the KainClaw Design foundation: system prompt contract, structured HTML/sliders parser, and provider-backed designEngine wrapper. Added focused tests and verified with npm test, npm run check, npm run build.

title: KainClaw Design V1 主线
description: 承接 `.kiro/specs/kainclaw-design.md`，把当前已完成的 Artifacts -> KainClaw Design bridge 扩展成真正可用的 KainClaw Design V1 主线。范围包括设计生成、workbench 预览/slider、局部 patch、版本快照、导出与必要的风格引导。已完成的 yd5 只覆盖 artifacts/bridge，不等于完整 Design workbench 已完成。
notes:
拆分原则：
1. 先打通 HTML + sliders + workbench 的最短闭环。
2. patch / 版本 / 导出分阶段串行推进，避免大一坨并行失控。
3. 先按不新增依赖的优先级推进；PPTX 这类需新依赖的能力不塞进首个导出任务。

- Current active artifact HTML is passed into the KainClaw Design surface
- Bridge works from Electron shell without introducing new business logic into renderer-only code
- npm test, npm run check, npm run build pass

Do not treat that protocol as a separate feature-track, and do not expand this issue into redesigning the Design Lab itself.

title: Avoid duplicate image POST on successful parse failures
description: The OpenAI-compatible image client currently retries to a fallback /v1 endpoint even after the primary endpoint returned HTTP 200, if the response body is successful but unparsable. Image generation and editing are not idempotent, so that retry can duplicate work and billing. Limit fallback retries to explicit wrong-endpoint signals only.
